title: Forearm, Neck, Core & Ab Accessories
author: W
desc:
Forearm & Neck work to be completed at the end of Upper Body days 
+
Ironclad ab training that hits the three core components of muscular hypertrophy: High Tension, Metabolic Stress, & Muscular Damage - To be completed at the end of Lower Body days.

ex.note: AMRAP with barbell only on final set.
If staying in rep range is too easy, progress by: slowing tempo, adding weight, or doing standing.

If staying in rep range is too easy, progress by: slowing tempo or adding weight.

If you can’t get 6 reps yet, just do more sets of fewer reps, like 5 sets of 3.
Finish with suitcase carries for 3 sets of 30 seconds per side.

Plank if too hard.
Longer sets if too easy.

If too easy, toes to bar. 

If too difficult, progress from captain’s chair knee raises, to hanging knee raises, to hanging leg raises.

OPTIONAL EXERCISE
One all out amrap set. Add weight once hitting 20 clean reps.
